name: Edel
source:
He has never appeared in "Eternal Blessing of the Stars"... or maybe he simply didn't have a character sprite?

Count Vicenzo Brillhart's butler... or is he even a butler? Rude, abrasive and untidy - how is he still employed?!

"Has she no brains, or is she simply fearless?"

[From [url=https://ant-san.itch.io/villainotome]itch.io[/url]]
